items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Georgia All came by to tell me because we were all very dear friends.

ctx.x: while, and he just died not too long ago here in Los Angeles. But he also was producing a show in Europe for the Ford Foundation. Some kind of jazz show over there. And he would bring all the big musicians from here, from America over there to do these shows. Mike was quite a guy.

But any way he died about a year ago, and Georgia All came by to tell me because we were all very dear friends. Now, I had to just inject that because I didn't -- I thought it would be of some interest to you. [PAUSE]
Somewhere back, I think on our second tape, you mentioned a white singer who sang like Billy Eckstein, but you couldn't remember his last name.
